mapper.sql: u.id, u.kind, u.owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, u.conversation_id AS conversationId, u.upload_request_id AS uploadRequestId, u.source_sha256 AS sourceSha256, u.asset_id AS assetId, u.file_name AS fileName, u.ext, u.mime, u.byte_size AS byteSize, u.duration_ms AS durationMs, u.width, u.height, u.cover_asset_id AS coverAssetId, u.state, u.message_id AS messageId, a.review_state AS reviewState, a.review_reason AS reviewReason
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_media_upload(kind, owner_member_id, conversation_id, upload_request_id, source_sha256, file_name, ext, mime, byte_size, state) VALUES (#{kind}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{conversationId}, #{uploadRequestId}, #{sourceSha256}, #{fileName}, #{ext}, #{mime}, #{byteSize}, 'RESERVED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_media_upload u LEFT JOIN app_media_asset a ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE u.owner_member_id = #{ownerId} AND u.kind = #{kind} AND u.upload_request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM im_media_upload u LEFT JOIN app_media_asset a ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE u.owner_member_id = #{ownerId} AND u.kind = #{kind} AND u.upload_request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT FROM im_media_upload u LEFT JOIN app_media_asset a ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM im_media_upload u LEFT JOIN app_media_asset a ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE u.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM im_media_upload u LEFT JOIN app_media_asset a ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE u.message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE im_media_upload SET asset_id = #{assetId}, state = 'UPLOADED' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE im_media_upload SET state = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'UPLOADED' AND message_id IS NULL
UPDATE im_media_upload SET message_id = #{messageId} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'UPLOADED' AND message_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.msg_type + 0 AS msgType, m.content, m.extra_json AS extraJson, m.status + 0 AS status, m.check_status + 0 AS checkStatus, m.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.name) AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar FROM im_message m LEFT JOIN ums_member u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId}
